text: 市场全天高开高走，创业板指午后涨超3%。算力硬件股大幅反弹，源杰科技、东山精密、光迅科技、剑桥科技等多股涨停，中际旭创、新易盛、天孚通信均涨超13%。AI漫剧概念继续活跃，上海电影涨停创新高，文投控股、凯撒文化等封板。机器人概念股延续强势，福莱新材2连板创新高，襄阳轴承、锋龙股份、瑞迪智驱等十余股涨停。下跌方面，光伏板块冲高回落，迈为股份跌近10%。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超3500股飘红，今日成交近1.69万亿。截止收盘沪指涨0.46%，深成指涨1.32%，创业板指涨3.11%。
text_en: The market opened higher and rose throughout the day, with the ChiNext Index gaining more than 3% in the afternoon. Computing power hardware stocks rebounded sharply, with Yuanjie Technology, Dongshan Precision, Accelink Technologies, Cambridge Technology and many others hitting the daily limit up, while Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink and TFC Optical Communication each rose more than 13%. The AI comic drama concept remained active, with Shanghai Film hitting the daily limit up to a new high, and Wintime Holdings and Kaiser Culture also sealing the limit up. Robotics concept stocks continued their strength, with Fulai New Materials posting a second consecutive limit-up to a new high, and more than ten stocks including Xiangyang Bearing, Fenglong Shares and Ruide Zhiqu hitting the limit up. On the downside, the photovoltaic sector rose then fell back, with Maxwell Technologies down nearly 10%. More stocks rose than fell, with over 3,500 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets in the green, and turnover today at nearly 1.69 trillion yuan. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.46%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.32%, and the ChiNext Index rose 3.11%.
